payload.title: Limatus: intent from first prose paragraph; numeric closers are not punch lines
payload.description: Two Limatus defects found scanning 102 published Anth.us pieces with the Anthus profile on branch plain-statement-checks. (1) document_intent is the MDX import line in 84 of 102 scans because intent takes the first sentence of any paragraph; it should take the first prose paragraph, which _prose_paragraph_spans already identifies. (2) Punch-line cadence flags short closing sentences that state a number ('A coin flip gets 0.5.', 'Jev's output is free.' is fine to flag, but a numeric statement is a measurement, not a riddle). Exempt sentences containing a digit or percent. Specs first (features/), then code, then behave + pytest green. PR into Limatus main (no develop branch there) with a LIM board issue.
